title: Logo Proportions
slide_intent: Teach designers to size a signature by the lowercase letters people actually see. Matching visible letter height gives a clearer comparison than matching the outside dimensions of the art.
strategic_value: The wordmark can retain a consistent relationship to a message even when headline sizes change.
demonstration: Three rows pair the word headline with the Instacart signature. The first identifies x-height, the second shows the usual half-height ratio, and the third shows one-third height for very large type.
practical_value: Measure the lowercase heights, then select the half or one-third relationship according to the scale of the headline.

content_islands.name: Sizing explanation
content_islands.spec: Place a short explanation of the x-height measurement at left.

content_islands.name: Measured comparisons
content_islands.spec: Stack the baseline specimen and two progressively smaller signatures at right. Use cyan annotations and captions to identify the ratios and their use cases.
